verdict.rationale: Neon documents instant restore and point-in-time branch restore (branch-restore docs), plus a 'finalize_restore' flag that swaps compute endpoints to a restored branch without changing connection strings, and the MCP tool surface includes 'Finalize branch restore from snapshot' and 'Recover a deleted project' tools for programmatic recovery. Branching itself is well documented and independently corroborated by community users describing branch/reset workflows for recovery-like use cases. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of restoring to an arbitrary point within a long retention window (vs. just branch reset), and explicit documentation of retention window limits per plan tier.
